qualifications.sourceReviewStatement: Original Code/Test reviewed in current author context; this is not fresh independent Reviewer approval.

findings.finding: System inventory fixes trusted disk root to C:\\; it does not prove that C: is the current Windows system volume on every supported machine. Diagnosis is a single snapshot with effect NONE and no root-cause assertion.
findings.claimScope: No general 'any system disk' or quantified speedup claim is justified from this source.
findings.oracle: With exact current Windows system root known from trusted Host, verify snapshot volume identity or return applicability UNKNOWN; ensure advice remains effect NONE and localOnly true.
findings.negativeCase: OS system root differs from C:; pretend C: free bytes describe actual system volume → must be rejected/qualified.

findings.finding: collectWindowsReadonlyDiagnosis refuses non-Windows/invalid observation and reports OBSERVED_ONLY. It cannot establish causality from process counts, an underlying disk failure or an effective automated optimization.
findings.claimScope: I1 observation candidate only; no mutating Function, active diagnosis of all sources, or independent end-user UI proof.
findings.oracle: Real Windows Host snapshot, bounded reliable provenance, correct error statuses and no local support-data egress; UI recheck separate.
findings.negativeCase: Missing native evidence, non-win32 platform or malformed memory/volume numbers → refuse; never return root-cause or effect success.

findings.finding: verifyStorageCleanup's checkId targets-within-scope is PASS whenever oracleInputs.scopeRoots is a nonempty array; that check does not compare actual journaled paths against authorized scope. Its test positive control uses arbitrary 'f.bin' with ['C:\\scope'] and expects task PASS. The lower-level executor separately performs scope checks; the weakness is specifically in the claimed INDEPENDENT verifier assertion, not proof of an out-of-scope OS deletion.
findings.claimScope: Do not claim independent target containment proof solely from the current verifier check or successful unit fixture; that guarantee needs stronger oracle/independent source and runtime evidence.
findings.oracle: An independent verifier must derive and bind exact authorized target IDs from trusted plan/Host; compare every journal/receipt action and affected file with that scope, including Windows path aliases/reparse races, and fail closed if evidence is incomplete.
findings.negativeCase: Trusted-looking receipt/journal records EXEC_DONE on an out-of-scope file while scopeRoots remains nonempty and reclaimed bytes match; independent verifier must FAIL/UNKNOWN, not PASS.

findings.finding: reclaimed-bytes-verified compares grossBytes against Σ journal EXEC_DONE file byte sizes, and records a post-growth-source directory measurement as context; it does not independently compare before/after volume free bytes. Journaled gross deleted file bytes are not necessarily actual free-space increase on every filesystem.
findings.claimScope: The R0 desired oracle 'Re-observed free-space delta' is an acceptance requirement, not evidence that existing code already verifies actual disk free-space change.
findings.oracle: Independently read target volume pre/post free bytes where the Product claims free space increase; distinguish physical free-space delta, journal gross, and regrowth/other concurrent writers; explain UNKNOWN if delta is not attributable.
findings.negativeCase: Journal says 100 bytes deleted but volume free bytes do not increase because of concurrent writes, shared extents, allocation behavior, etc.; never present 100 bytes as measured free-space increase.

findings.finding: Bounded storage vertical has its own action/controller/legacy authorization flows, and generic K→C Windows Host effect adapter and selected-root control route exist. These separate source components do not, by themselves, establish that the selected-root UI production journey invokes precisely the bounded storage cleanup Function via selected K Permit and Shun Host; actual composition, exact action identity and both-level postconditions remain to be proved.
findings.claimScope: No transfer of a separate storage benchmark or generic Host effect adapter PASS to an end-to-end CA-JOB-03 claim.
findings.oracle: Trace a real approved selected-root task from UI caseId to Host-picked exact scope, immutable plan/grant, K Permit, ActionController and OS currentness, actual bounded cleanup, durable journal, independent protected-asset and free-space postconditions, and UI history.
findings.negativeCase: Forged {path,plan,grant,permit}, mismatched caseId/selected-root, stale grant, duplicated action across restart, partial deletion or UI-only fake success → BLOCKED/UNKNOWN with no automatic replay.

findings.finding: executeBoundedCleanup explicitly sets postStateVerified:false and delegates semantic verification to a separate post-execution verifier; the generic Windows effect host completes K only when a trusted WindowsEffectPort receipt declares COMPLETED_VERIFIED and postStateVerified true. The conversion and independently verified proof are separate obligations.
findings.claimScope: An executor SUCCEEDED terminal alone is not a completed, independently verified K task outcome.
findings.oracle: Verify actual composition to a trusted postcondition receipt after semantic checks, bound to same action/effect ID, with durable evidence and no premature COMPLETED.
findings.negativeCase: Executor returns SUCCEEDED with postStateVerified false; K must remain running/UNKNOWN until distinct independent verifier evidence and reconciliation.

recommendedOrder.action: Treat CA-JOB-02 as the first real read-only/low-risk observation oracle; bind actual Windows edition, system volume identity, privacy and truthful OBSERVED_ONLY UI result; never infer optimization effect.
Independently review verifier target-scope and gross-vs-free-space evidence for CA-JOB-03 before declaring a correct Function postcondition; propose negative tests.
Trace selected-root UI/Host/K/ActionController effect identity through actual production composition and durable journal; no future mutation without approved Product/Task admission.
Require separate SAP qualification and K/C/Host native effect poststate receipt; fail closed on mismatch, partial, stale approval or unknown effect.

excluded: No new product scope or automated execution
No invented root cause, storage free-space delta or Native PASS
No independent Gate signature by author
No regression of existing PR #414/#415 historical reviewer or Node receipt

redTeamCases.requirement: Actual journal action/path outside the independently authorized scope with a syntactically nonempty scopeRoots must not pass independent scope verification
Journal gross deleted bytes cannot be reported as an observed increase of volume free bytes without a separate volume reading
K effect cannot become terminal from SUCCEEDED alone when postStateVerified=false or Host authorization/context changes
If Windows system volume differs from C:, require truthful provenance/refusal rather than claiming fixed C: is the system root
